shape.text: A team API key is the prefix e2b_ followed by exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters, 44 in all, with no separator and no checksum. The provider's key package sets the prefix and generates 20 random bytes, hex-encoded; its legacy SQL generator and a local-development seed test agree. The grammar comes from provider code, because the documentation names the variable and shows placeholders only.
The server-side verifier accepts an uppercase-hex body that the generator never issues, so the issued grammar is lowercase only.

issuance.text: The key is carried in the E2B_API_KEY environment variable and sent in the X-API-Key header. It creates and controls sandboxes on the team's quota.
No E2B key was issued or observed for this record.
